findings.detail: The R5 packet:19 requires carrying recovery source/tests byte-exact unless an indispensable related correction is proven. recovery_gate.py:9071 adds hybrid-validator timeout diagnostics, but the R5 implementation evidence records no corresponding exception and still claims preservation. Its recorded recovery_gate.py SHA256 is 38da91330fe962729300f36e32bfdd5857501bad9dcceadee0238d3ecec0a906; staged bytes hash to 8ccd5702ba63c048bbc727115014129b731ef5c8847a8ab187a2d4034f80813e. Removing only that timeout hunk in memory reproduces the recorded hash exactly. Recorded final hashes also differ for test_commit_executor_local_review.py and test_recovery_gate.py. The current package needs an explicit disposition of these subsequent changes.
